title: stynx baseline error contract
description: Baseline error catalog. The current StynxErrorFilter passes Nest HttpException bodies through and emits core StynxError as {code,message,context?}; the envelope below is an architectural target, not the literal runtime shape of every response. Adopters extending with domain-specific errors author per-module *.errors.json files that reference this baseline.

errorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error identifier, format: `<DOMAIN>:<CATEGORY>:<DETAIL>`, e.g. `BOOKMARK:NOT_FOUND:by-id`

message.description: Human-readable explanation; safe to log + display

details.description: Optional per-error metadata; shape depends on errorCode

runtimeBody.message: Tenant source conflict: Host and X-Tenant-Id disagree

baseline_errors.description: On a public tenant route, raw Host selects the tenant and the configured tenant header disagrees. Header name in the message follows configuration; a registered translator may localize the message.

runtimeBody.message: Tenant source conflict: Host and authenticated claim disagree

baseline_errors.description: On an optional-auth public tenant route, a verified bearer tenant claim disagrees with the tenant selected by raw Host. A registered translator may localize the message.
Existing protected-route denial for absent or inactive membership, or a verified actor without membership in the public Host tenant. Never downgrade that verified actor to the nominal public actor.
Request body, query, or headers fail validation. Triggered by class-validator decorator chain on DTOs.
No bearer token or invalid bearer token presented. Issued by StynxAuthGuard.
Bearer token is well-formed but expired or revoked.
Authenticated but lacking the @Permission()-declared scope for this endpoint.
Path-parameter-keyed resource not found in the caller's tenant scope. Distinct from AUTH:FORBIDDEN — uses NotFoundException to avoid leaking existence across tenants.
Idempotency key already used for a different request body. Caller should not retry with the same key + different payload.
A present If-Match tag is malformed or does not match the current resource revision. The method-scoped IfMatchExceptionFilter emits the law envelope; safe details are optional.
A route marked with @RequireIfMatch() received no If-Match header. The method-scoped IfMatchExceptionFilter emits the law envelope; safe details are optional.
Tenant exceeded its per-window quota. Honor the `Retry-After` header.
Catch-all for unhandled exceptions. message is sanitized (no stack trace, no internal details). Detailed information is in the audit log keyed by requestId.
Downstream dependency (DB, S3, Cognito) did not respond within the configured timeout. Caller may retry.

extension_pattern: Adopter modules add per-module errors.json files (e.g. `domain/demo-bookmark/api/docs/errors.json`) that enumerate domain-specific errorCodes following the `<DOMAIN>:<CATEGORY>:<DETAIL>` shape. These extend (do not replace) the baseline above.

authority.promoted_during: stynx U5 batch (2026-05-17) to close F1×T8 spec_robustness_targets in INV-ERROR-001's measurement chain.
